summary: Chelan County, WA 28-foot L-4 timber lookout from Chelan Butte; first built 1936 or 1938 depending on source; moved to the Columbia Breaks Fire Interpretive Center in 1995.

facts.design: 28-foot treated timber tower with a Plan L-4 lookout cab

access.note: Lookout interior is open only during center events or by special arrangement (CBFIC). WTA describes three short trails at the center; no entry fee

visit.trail_note: At the Columbia Breaks Fire Interpretive Center just north of Entiat; the Washington Trails Association lists no entry fee

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service / Washington Department of Natural Resources (original site)

events.note: First tower, a 40-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab, per the FFLOS register and FireLookout.com. The NRHP nomination does not mention it
NRHP: a Civilian Conservation Corps crew built the road, tower and cabin in 1938 under Sim Beeson
The first 40-foot pole tower burned; the year is not given
Replaced by a 28-foot treated timber tower with an L-4 cab
Staffed sporadically into the 1990s, per the FFLOS register and FireLookout.com
Listed 12/27/1990 as part of the USDA Forest Service Fire Lookouts on Wenatchee NF multiple property listing; the listing describes the summit site
Moved to the Columbia Breaks Fire Interpretive Center, 1 mile north of Entiat beside Highway 97
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register 21 August 2012

corrections.why: The FFLOS register and FireLookout.com both date the move to the Columbia Breaks Fire Interpretive Center to 1995.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLOS register and FireLookout.com say a 40-foot pole tower was built in 1936, burned, and was replaced in 1939. The 1988 NRHP nomination dates the road, tower and cabin to 1938 and does not mention an earlier tower. The record's 1938 date (from Wikidata) agrees with the NRHP. Both dates are kept as events.

The NRHP nomination, written in 1988, says the lookout had not been used for fire surveillance for several years. The FFLOS register and FireLookout.com say it was staffed sporadically into the 1990s. Unstaffed is dated from the 1990s, with this gap noted.

sources.title: Chelan Butte Lookout, National Register of Historic Places nomination (NRIS 90001912)

notes_for_editor: Built date is disputed: the record's 1938 (Wikidata, matching the NRHP) against a 1936 first tower and 1939 replacement in the FFLOS and FireLookout.com. The NRHP listing (NRIS 90001912, 12/27/1990) describes the summit site before the 1995 move, so it may not describe the current exhibit. Visit Wenatchee places the center on US Highway 97 while the center's own page says Highway 97A; the story omits the route. Parent record us-wa-chelan-butte (status relocated) was not edited.
